pick.reason: The type-only rough reads in under two seconds at both sizes. The headline carries the canvas, the accent sits on "stays." only, the margins already hold, and it needs the fewest notes to reach the bar.
pick.lost: 1: on linkedin the supporting line floats alone at top right, so reading order breaks and the headline is too small for the half it owns. 2: on linkedin "Drafts," collides with the descender of "stays.", and the surface block over the ink background is a box inside a box.
notes: ig-post: headline line height from about 1.1 to 1.0 and top padding to 72px. The whole headline block, including the descender of "y", has to end above 540px, the top 40% (brief, must be true). It currently runs to about 580px.

ig-post: once note 1 lands, keep the supporting line and mark anchored at the bottom. Mark baseline no lower than 1215px (10% bottom safe zone). The empty band between the headline and "Drafts," then measures about 430px, under the one-third limit of 450px (standard, "owns the whole canvas"). Do not add any element to that band.
Both sizes: set headline letter spacing explicitly to -0.015em, inside the -0.02em to -0.01em range the standard requires above 40px.

Both sizes: snap every size to the brand scale and keep it to three per size. Linkedin: headline 127px, supporting line 40px, mark 30px. Ig-post: headline 169px, supporting line 72px, mark 30px. If 169px on ig-post fails note 1, keep 169px and drop the top padding to 64px rather than shrinking the type further.
Linkedin: align the baselines of "Drafts, not versions." and "quill.app" exactly, both 48px above the bottom edge. Keep 72px left and right margins on an 8px grid.

composition: ig-post: the headline now ends at about 425px (the descender of "y"), but "Drafts," starts at about 1000px. That leaves an empty band of about 570px, over the 450px one-third limit. Raise the supporting line block 144px so the cap top of "Drafts," sits at 856px, which brings the band to about 430px. Keep the "quill.app" baseline at 1205px and put nothing in the band.

spacing: ig-post: after the raise, set the gap from the "not versions." baseline to the "quill.app" baseline at 232px, on the 8px grid. Linkedin: keep both bottom baselines at 579px (48px above the bottom edge) and both side margins at 72px.
